text.en:
Barangays Bas-Lugus, Witwit, Bas Numuk, Larap, Mantam, Lugasan, Gapas, Pa-et, Alu
Duyung, Laha, Alu, Kawayan, Bas Mangkallay, Kayawan Subah, and Tingkangan, all in the Municipality of
Tapul, Province of Sulu, are hereby detached and separated from said Municipality and constituted and
created into a separate, distinct and independent municipality to be known as the Municipality of Lugas,
Province of Sulu, without effecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother Municipality of Tapul.
The seat of the government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Alu, and that of the
Municipality of Tapul shall be in Barangay Kalang.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities, shall be applicable to the Municipality of Lugus.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Tapul shall continue to perform
their duties as such officials in the newly created Municipality of Lugus until the municipal officials of the
latter municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office
until their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipal officials following the
issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed, at pleasure, by the President. Such
appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel
of the Municipality of Lugus shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Lugus in the obligations, funds,
assets and other property of the Municipality of Tapul shall be transferred by the President to the newly
created municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 23rd day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
